import os,json,pathlib,stat,hashlib,gzip
src=pathlib.Path('/home/alex/work/pocket4-signal-runtime-r5-work-01/owned-unit-control-02')
out=pathlib.Path('/home/alex/work/pocket4-signal-r5-fixture02-export-01')
assert src.is_dir() and not src.is_symlink()
items=sorted(src.rglob('*'))
assert len(items)<=128
files=[];excluded=[]
for p in items:
 s=p.lstat()
 if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):continue
 assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
 assert s.st_size<=524288,str(p)
 b=p.read_bytes(); row={'path':str(p.relative_to(src)),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
 if 'journal' in p.name.lower() or p.suffix in ['.log','.gz']:
  excluded.append(row);continue
 try:t=b.decode('utf-8')
 except UnicodeDecodeError:excluded.append(row);continue
 row['content']=t;files.append(row)
body=json.dumps({'schema':1,'source_root':str(src),'files':files,'excluded_files':excluded},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
assert len(body)<=1048576
z=gzip.compress(body,mtime=0)
out.mkdir(mode=0o755)
p=out/'bundle.json.gz'
fd=os.open(p,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o444)
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(z);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
print(json.dumps({'state':'EXPORTED_OWNED_FIXTURE02_EVIDENCE','path':str(p),'files':len(files),'excluded':excluded,'gzip_bytes':len(z),'gzip_sha256':hashlib.sha256(z).hexdigest(),'text_bytes':len(body),'text_sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}))
